summary: Kootenai NF site in Lincoln County: a 1920s log cabin burned in 1931, a 10-foot pole L-4 tower built 1933, in ruins by 1975; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: In ruins by 1975 per both sources; no source describes what remains today

notes_for_editor: Two short site pages and one list; no staffing, fire record or photo beyond the FFLOS image already on the record. One search found nothing about this site. It returned Rock Candy Mountain and a Rock Candy Trail (461) in the Yaak, a Washington Rock Candy Mountain, and Yaak Mountain lookout history mentioning an August 1931 fire death; none is tied to this site, so none is used. Before publishing at higher confidence, check Kootenai NF Libby or Troy district records. The register's 'Gone' status is from the firelookout.org list, not the FFLOS page.
